Wiki / Settings

Settings reference

All 94 source-defined settings, including saved header preferences and internal state. Hidden settings often have controls in the header editor or a tool window; others are implementation state.

Defaults below are initial source values. Existing saved preferences, migrations and dependency checks can differ. Use the linked guide for current behavior.
